records.name: The Grey Net
records.activity: Cargo diversion, dockside theft, false handling claims, and resale
records.area: Old Quays and older warehouse lanes
records.limits: Cannot control harbor operations or guarantee access to every warehouse.

records.name: The Bent Seal
records.activity: Forged cargo marks, altered receipts, false ownership papers, and commercial fraud
records.area: Market Ward and Harbor Office approaches
records.limits: Cannot create genuine legal authority or survive careful examination of every document.

records.name: The Quiet Account
records.activity: Debt collection, coercive lending, intimidation, and private settlements
records.area: Market Ward, Old Quays lodging houses, and edges of the New Quays
records.limits: Not a bank or monopoly; relies on reputation and intimidation.
